sentences.text: This petition is filed by the in-laws, brother-in-law and sister-in-laws i.e., accused Nos.2 to 6 against whom the 2nd respondent (wife) lodged a complaint for the offences punishable under Sections 498A and 506 of IPC read with Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act which ultimately has culminated in filing of the charge sheet.
2. A reading of the complaint would reveal that the entire set of allegations are directed only against the husband.

The complaint and the charge sheet indicate that the husband and wife were staying in Dubai for 2 years and it is the averment in the complaint that the husband used to ill-treat, abuse and assault the wife while she was staying in Dubai along with him.
It is the further averment in the complaint that the salary that she was earning in Dubai was being collected by her husband and sent to his parents.

In the light of the fact that the entire set of allegations are only directed against the husband and allegations against in-laws, brother-in-law and sisters-in- law were general and omnibus in nature,
there is absolutely no justification to continue the proceedings as against accused Nos.2 to 6, more so, when there is no material to indicate that the salary that the 2nd respondent was earning was being collected by her husband and sent to his parents from Dubai.
I am, therefore, of the view that the proceedings against the petitioners herein i.e., accused Nos.2 to 6 cannot be sustained and the same is accordingly quashed.
It is, however, made clear that the proceedings shall continue as against accused No.1/husband.
4. The petition is accordingly disposed of.
